routine: 복습 3분(영어 가리고 먼저 쓰기) → 가리고 써 보기 2분(빈칸 먼저, 맨 끝 정답 확인) → 새 내용 5분(노트에 옮길 때 짝 표현째로) → 소리 내어 3번 읽기 3분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

experts.line: 뜻은 아는데 문장 속에서 꺼내지 못한다. 옮겨 적기 전에 먼저 가리고 써 볼 것.
whether·once·until 뒤에는 주어·동사부터. 누가 할지 안 보이면 현지 직원이 되묻는다.

scorecard.change: 단어 앞에 "가리고 써 보기" 칸, 패턴마다 뼈대 한 줄.
scorecard.focus: B 빈칸(첫 글자 힌트)과 영작의 절(주어·동사)이 약함. 점수·틀린 문제는 성적 탭(비공개 기록)에서.

review.title: 복습 (10/22 표현 + 오답, 영어로 먼저 써 보기)

cover_practice.prompt: 막다: Please cover the leaking spots to p______ water damage.
분명히 하다: Please c______ the size on loops 1 and 2 with MR.
폐기하다: Please d______ o_ the old cartons by Friday.
불일치: We found a d___________ between the PKL and the hanging sheet.
진행하다: Please p______ w___ the ticket booking after the PR is approved.

words.meaning: 막다, 미리 방지하다 — so that ~ doesn't happen again 대신
words.example: I changed the format to prevent the same mistakes.

words.meaning: 분명히 하다, 정확히 확인하다 — check / explain 대신
words.example: Could you clarify which task each person does?
words.collocations: clarify the reason / clarify with someone

words.example: We will dispose of the broken pallets after sorting.
Please check any discrepancy between the QR data and the customs balance.
words.collocations: a discrepancy between A and B

words.example: We can proceed with the PR after Mr Moon approves it.
words.collocations: proceed with the order / proceed as planned

patterns.meaning: 왜 ~인지 설명해 주시겠어요? (Why did you ~? 대신, 따지는 느낌을 줄임)
patterns.skeleton: why + [주어][동사] (why did you change ✕ / why the quantity was changed ○)
patterns.email: Could you explain why the quantity was changed in the WIP list?
patterns.spoken: Can you tell me why it changed?

patterns.meaning: 앞으로는 ~해 주세요 (From now on 대신, 규칙 안내)
patterns.email: Going forward, please cc Nga on all accounting emails.
patterns.spoken: From now on, always cc Nga.

patterns.pattern: I understand your concern about ~, but ~.
patterns.email: I understand your concern about water spreading, but we only need to cover the leaking spots.
patterns.spoken: I get your point, but we only need to cover the leaks.

rewrite.improved: Could you explain why [수량] was changed to "[항목]"?
rewrite.note: Why did you ~? 는 직원이 추궁받는다고 느끼기 쉽다. Could you explain why ~? 로 바꾸면 같은 질문이 정중해진다. why 뒤는 평서문 어순(주어 [수량] + 동사 was changed) — 지난 시험에서 틀린 whether 뒤 어순과 같은 규칙.
